attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (RHEL 10). Installed aide, verified the distro-default aide.conf already covers /etc comprehensively (explicit rules for ~90 paths plus a catch-all "/etc PERMS"), initialized the database, and confirmed detection works by modifying /etc/hosts and observing AIDE flag it, then restoring and re-baselining cleanly (36014 entries, zero diffs). Added /etc/cron.daily/aide-check to run daily checks and log results via logger for ongoing reporting. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id and aide.db.gz hash pre-restart, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until the node returned, proved the boot_id changed, and confirmed the AIDE database hash was unchanged and `aide --check` still reports no differences post-reboot, with crond active and the daily script intact.
